title: Allow disabling `Select All` in `st.multiselect`
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Hello! I'd like the possibility to remove the `Select All` / `Select N matches` buttons in `st.multiselect` & similar components. (note: examples taken from [`st.multiselect` doc page](https://docs.streamlit.io/develop/api-reference/widgets/st.multiselect)) ## Bad UX impact 👉 Basically I want to be able to search something and press Enter, and have the first match added to the selected options. Currently searching then pressing Enter would `Select N matches` which is not wanted here 😬 For searches that have only 1 match it is already working as expected. ### Why? In our case we have a list of ~500 clients and allow the user to select maybe 2-3, having the `Select All` button doesn't make sense here.. ### How? This could be a new parameter on `st.multiselect` like `allow_select_all=False` Although that naming isn't great if a `Deselect All` option would exist as well 🤔 ### Additional Context _No response_

This is an enhancement request to make `st.multiselect`'s bulk actions ("Select all" / "Select N matches") optional. Today those actions are always injected as the first dropdown item when more than one option is visible and the list has fewer than 1000 options (`useMultiselectFiltering.ts`), so pressing Enter after a multi-match search activates the bulk action instead of selecting the first match. A product spec for a configurable `select_all` parameter already exists in open PR #15300 (intended to close the earlier duplicate #14918), but the API has not landed in code yet—only the hard-coded 1000-option threshold.

### Related Issues

- [#14918](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/14918) — **Near duplicate (closed):** Same request for a parameter to enable/disable "Select all" on `st.multiselect`. Closed after the `select_all` spec was drafted in [#15300](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15300); this issue should likely track against that PR/spec.
- [#15299](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15299) — Closely related (closed): Also asked to disable "Select all" (performance freeze on large lists); covered by the same `select_all` spec / threshold behavior.
- [#15697](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/15697) — Related (open): Customizable keyboard navigation for select/multiselect widgets; overlaps with the Enter-to-select-first-match UX called out here.
